checklist.label: Act 1
checklist.title: Base and the first two Arks

steps.text: Reach the base, answer the communicator, create the first Alter
Place the first outpost on any deposit
Pet the sheep near the base with E
Craft an item, hover it, middle-click to set a production order
Build the Refinery and run one job
Research and build the quantum computer upgrade
Expand the base once
trophies: Look at all this new space!

steps.text: Stock radiation filters before the magnetic storm
Botanist: let him take the Lena conversation
steps.deadline: His lesson needs the Lena hand-off that only happens in Act 1.

steps.text: Refiner: craft dumbbells, research the gym, install them
Scientist: accept rush work and keep it running 2+ days
Worker: accept five days without crunch
Miner: refuse the drugs, choose the Technician’s serum
steps.deadline: The refusal and the serum choice are one-time events right after he is created.

steps.text: Guard: hand over personal items to lift his mood
Install the four bridge piers, then hold E to travel out
Build two Rapidium Arks at base stage 2
Technician: find the park chip and build the park
steps.deadline: The park must be built in Act 2 — skipping it blocks the storyline for the whole run.

steps.text: Scientist: finish his private research before you travel out
steps.deadline: The Act 3 polymer delivery depends on this research being completed here.

steps.text: Botanist: ask, call Lena, craft the axe, deliver it
steps.deadline: The axe task only exists in Act 2.

steps.text: Doctor: cook the feast and reflect with him after
steps.deadline: The feast only exists in Act 2; the tattoo chain depends on it.

steps.text: Psychologist: brew the tea and drink it with him
Guard: keep 4–6 mush, accept surveillance, question every suspect
steps.deadline: The theft event needs two or three days with at least 3 mush left each day.

steps.text: Miner: two counselling rounds in the meditation room
steps.deadline: The late-return events and both counselling rounds must land before the act ends.

steps.text: Worker: five no-crunch days
Walk into 20 anomalies while exploring
Save, then choose the treatment at the kitchen meeting
steps.deadline: Irreversible: the choice decides the ending route and which Alters stay.

steps.text: Keep Tabula Rasa alive if you want Awareness
steps.deadline: Sacrificing him at the kitchen meeting makes Awareness impossible in that run.

steps.text: Build the third and fourth Rapidium Arks
Find the rebel base through the fog
Bring the rebels back, using Pragmatism to persuade
steps.deadline: Everything below that needs the Psychologist waits on this.

steps.text: Only now: the Doctor’s tattoo via the Psychologist’s design
steps.deadline: Tattooing him before the rebels return costs three trophies at once.

steps.text: Refiner: promise help, call Lena, use Reliance or Pragmatism
steps.deadline: The call has to happen before the rescue preparation ends.

steps.text: Worker: give him the badge found behind the base
steps.deadline: He only accepts the badge after the rebels are back.

steps.text: Scientist: deliver 10 polymer, let him leave, say goodbye
steps.deadline: The goodbye must happen before the final meeting with the rescue team.

steps.text: Guard: handle the quantum computer fight with Charisma
steps.deadline: The fight fires a few days after the rescue plan is prepared.

steps.text: Psychologist: accept the night counselling
steps.deadline: Stay in the captain’s room at night — do not sleep the day away.

steps.text: Base to level 4 and install every module
Build the fifth Rapidium Ark
Finish Act 3 and reach the rescue preparation
Save before saying goodbye to the Alters
steps.deadline: Every ending below is reloaded from this one save.

steps.text: Finish on the implant route
Finish on the sacrifice route
At the rescue team: do nothing
Craft the bomb, install it, then detonate
Accept the Botanist’s swap, then do nothing
trophies: The things we do for love

steps.text: Accept the swap, then detonate
Place the first Terraformer
Start Phased Rapidium, Proxylium and Megafluid production
Create the same Alter a second time
steps.deadline: No guide documents the trigger — keep a manual save before experimenting.

steps.text: Complete every Scientist Alter storyline in the DLC
Finish the Last Variable campaign

steps: Play through the opening and walk to the base at the end of the first area.
After reaching the base, answer the communicator.
Walk into the quantum computer room and create your first Alter.
Unlock the outpost in the base technology page.
Place your first outpost on any resource deposit on the map.
Activate the base to leave the prologue area.

achievements.name: The Bridge
achievements.description: Build a bridge over the lava river

steps: Run the Refinery to produce polymers.
Build the bridge piers in the workshop and install all four of them around the lava river.
Install the fourth bridge pier to complete the bridge over the lava river.
Collect enough organics, return to the command room, open the journey page and hold E to move the base out of the Act 1 map.
Finish the Act 2 objectives, then travel out from the command room journey page.
Complete the rescue-preparation objectives at the end of Act 3 and continue to the finale.
In Act 3, follow the wheel tracks out of the starting area.
Pass through the foggy stretch and turn right into the cave where light shines through the rocks at the far end.

achievements.name: Corporate Plug
achievements.description: Start treating the brain mutation using implants

steps: After the MRI results, talk to Scientist Jan, then call Lena and wait for her implant proposal.
Manufacture the requested number of implants in the workshop.
At the kitchen meeting, pick the corporation implant plan.
warnings: Act 2 branch choice: this is mutually exclusive with Bold Science for that playthrough.
It locks in the corporation ending — keep a manual save before the kitchen meeting if you want the Maxwell route too.

achievements.name: Bold Science
achievements.description: Start treating the brain mutation using experimental therapy

steps: After the MRI results, talk to Scientist Jan, then to Lucas and wait for Maxwell to call.
Follow Maxwell on the call, then research the quantum computer hack and upgrade the computer to create Tabula Rasa.
At the kitchen meeting three days later, choose to sacrifice Tabula Rasa.
warnings: Act 2 branch choice: mutually exclusive with Corporate Plug and with the Tabula Rasa party member (Awareness).
Sacrificing Tabula Rasa means the rebels cannot be persuaded back in Act 3.

steps: Act 2: after the MRI results, Technician Jan asks you to build a park — find the holographic park chip while exploring (through a cave with trees and running water, past the treeline).
Unlock and build the park, then talk to him while he is using it.
Act 3: get the rebels back and finish the supply-pack task; refuse the "last words" he offers in the second conversation.
warnings: The park must be built in Act 2; skipping it blocks the storyline.
On the Tabula Rasa route he cannot be persuaded back — the storyline then resolves after you finish his resource task.

steps: Act 2: agree with his research plans and complete his private research in the technology page before leaving the act.
Act 3: keep choosing the friendly options, then give him 10 polymer so he can go exploring.
After he returns, visit the location he mentions, then let him leave once the rescue research is done and say goodbye.
warnings: The storyline spans Act 2 and Act 3 and is easy to run out of time on — do not let Act 3 tick down before the polymer delivery.

Reports differ on the Act 2 requirement: one full guide says the treatment route does not matter, another says it only triggered on the Maxwell/Tabula Rasa route. Keep a save before the kitchen meeting.

steps: Act 2: admit the existence of the Alters to Lena and take the implant treatment.
After his Optimism lesson, promise to help with Ben and ask Lucas about him.
Act 3: follow Lena's route to bring the rebels back, then use Reliance or Pragmatism when you call Lena about Ben.
warnings: Requires the implant route and the rebels brought back — both are Act 2/Act 3 decisions you cannot undo without a reload.

steps: Act 3: after the rescue light fails, he asks for a carving stone and a tool — craft the tool in the workshop.
Pick up the dark reddish stone at the top of the large tree to the right of the ocean, on the way to the scientist scan sites.
Hand both over and stay empathetic throughout the conversation.
warnings: The stone is on a required route but is easy to walk past — grab it during the scan quest.

steps: Act 1: let Botanist Jan speak to Lena in your place, then follow his preferences (own your mistakes, praise Lena).
Act 2: admit the Alters to Lena, then take his axe task — ask Scientist Jan about it, call Lena, and craft the axe.
Deliver the axe, choose "There is only one axe", and agree with his advice.
warnings: Missing the Act 1 conversation with Lena blocks the axe task that unlocks this storyline.

steps: Act 2: keep at least 4 (ideally 6) portions of mush so the kitchen theft event can run.
Agree to his surveillance plan, build and install the equipment in the command room, and let him investigate.
Act 3: during the fight at the quantum computer, use the Worker's Charisma lesson to make him reflect, or agree with his plan and later tell him the data is useless.
warnings: Refusing the surveillance plan interrupts both his lesson and his storyline.
His storyline triggers at the very end of Act 3, so do not let the act expire first.

steps: Act 2: cook the feast in the kitchen, join the evening gathering and reflect on it with him — the doctor must stay, so take the implant route.
Act 3: build the tattoo machine, bring the rebels (and the Psychologist) back, and ask the Psychologist for the Naranath Bhranthan design.
Suggest that design to the doctor and finish the following conversation.
warnings: The implant route in Act 2 is mandatory — the Psychologist must be persuaded back in Act 3 to hand over the design.

steps: Act 2: help him prepare his special tea (materials in the workshop, processed in the kitchen) and drink it with him.
Act 3: bring the rebels back so he returns, then accept his counselling in your quarters at night.
warnings: Do not choose to sleep through the night at the end of Act 3 — the event only fires if you are in the captain's room.

steps: Act 2: on the implant route, tell Scientist Jan to chip the Worker while he sleeps if he refuses the implant, then pacify him with the Refiner's factory soup.
Act 3: bring the rebels back as early as possible, then find his personal item (a scout/Ocelot badge) near the Interal, behind the base past the irradiated area, and give it to him.
warnings: The badge only resolves the storyline after the rebels are back — leave it too late in Act 3 and the achievement is gone.

steps: Talk to Technician Jan in Act 1 until he asks for something for the crew (a recreation room — several players receive the request after the first Rapidium Ark).
Fulfil it, then agree with his point when he confronts you about following orders.
Act 1: let Botanist Jan take the conversation with Lena in your place.
Follow his preferences in the follow-up talk — own your mistakes, praise Lena.
A few days later take his second conversation to the end and the lesson lands.
warnings: Create him in Act 1 so the Lena conversation can hand off to him.

steps: Refuse to give Miner Jan drugs when the complaint event fires; help him take the arm off.
Choose Technician Jan's serum over the prosthetic, research it, brew it in the kitchen and deliver it.
Let him overwork on the mining machine until the late-return event fires twice, then put him in the meditation room for the Psychologist's two counselling rounds.
warnings: The serum choice (not the prosthetic) is what unlocks the later counselling chain.

steps: Act 2: accept Worker Jan's request to go five days without crunch and keep the radiation filters stocked.
Talk to him at the end of the five days and keep acknowledging workers' rights.
Craft the dumbbells in the workshop and give them to Refiner Jan.
Research and build the gym module, install the dumbbells in it, then take his follow-up conversation.
Take the implant route in Act 2 so Doctor Jan stays.
Act 3: bring the rebels back (the Psychologist included) before touching the tattoo quest.
Get the Naranath Bhranthan design from the Psychologist and suggest it to the doctor.
warnings: Finishing the tattoo quest before the rebels return permanently costs both this lesson and New perspective.

steps: Act 2: help the Psychologist make his special tea — prepare the materials in the workshop, process them in the kitchen.
Drink it with him, share feelings, and finish the conversation.
Act 2: give Guard Jan personal items first so his mood is high, then let the mush theft event run for two or three days with at least 3 portions left each day.
Agree to his surveillance plan, build the equipment, install it in the command room and let him work.
Question every suspect he names, then confront him after speaking to Scientist Jan.
warnings: Letting the mush count drop below 3 ends the theft event and with it the lesson.

achievements.name: Joy of life
achievements.description: Learn the Tabula Rasa’s lesson - Joy of Life

steps: Act 2: research the quantum computer hack, create Tabula Rasa, but then take the implant plan at the kitchen meeting so he joins the crew in Act 3.
Teach him his name when he wakes up in Act 3.
When he stands at the airlock looking outside, agree that the sky is worth appreciating.
warnings: Sacrificing Tabula Rasa in Act 2 removes both this lesson and Awareness.

steps: Create Scientist Jan and take his first chats about his feelings.
Accept his rush-work request and keep "Enable Rush" running for more than two days.
Pick the "I learned something" option in the conversation that follows.
warnings: Crunch tanks the crew's mood — schedule movie nights and games while it runs, and turn rush off once the lesson lands.

achievements.name: Awareness
achievements.description: Unexpected member stays with the crew

steps: Act 2: talk to both Maxwell and Lena about treatment, then research Maxwell's quantum computer hack.
Create Tabula Rasa with the quantum computer and manufacture the company implants.
Take the implant plan at the kitchen meeting — Tabula Rasa then survives into Act 3 as a crew member.
Teach him the name "Jan" in the first conversation after you wake up.
warnings: Both treatment branches have to be pushed to their prerequisites before the kitchen meeting.
Choosing to sacrifice Tabula Rasa (Bold Science) makes this achievement impossible in that run.

steps: Research the quantum computer upgrade on the technology page and build it.
Finish every module research on the base technology page, including the radiation suppressor.
Build and install each module on the base.
At the end of Act 3, install the materialization and transport modules to finish the set.

achievements.name: Reunited
achievements.description: Convince the rebels to come back

steps: Act 2: take the implant route and confess the Alters to Lena.
Act 3: work with Lena on a plan for the Alters, then take the supply-pack task from Technician Jan.
When he asks whether there is a way out of the corporation's plan, offer Lena's freedom route and use the Scientist's Pragmatism option to persuade him.
warnings: On the Tabula Rasa / Maxwell route the rebels cannot be persuaded back at all — this achievement requires the implant route.

achievements.name: Not Just An Object
achievements.description: Give every Alter at least one personal item

steps: Find the personal item boxes while exploring each act — every small landing pod with a balloon marks one.
Hand each box to its owner and create the Alters you skipped in the previous run so all of them can receive one.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: you cannot have every possible Alter in one playthrough — each has its own trophies attached, so plan the missing ones for a second run.
warnings: Needs at least two playthroughs, because Act 2 sends some Alters away for good.

steps: Create the alters that branch away from your Act 2 treatment choice in a first run.
In a second run, create the ones you skipped — Technician, Scientist, Miner, Refiner, Worker and Guard on the Maxwell route covers the rest.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: many trophies are mutually exclusive between the two treatment paths, so a second run is the intended route to 100%.
warnings: At least two playthroughs are required — the Act 2 treatment choice decides which Alters stay.

steps: Upgrade the base to the stage that unlocks the second Ark, then build it in the command room.
Upgrade the base further and build the third Rapidium Ark in the command room.
Expand the base again and build the fourth Rapidium Ark.
Slow down each act — reaching the end-of-act stage early costs you the special Interal veins.
Two Arks in Act 1, two more in Act 2 once the base is fully expanded, and the fifth in Act 3.
warnings: Ark slots are gated by base stage, not by resources — rush the base upgrades, not the act timer.

achievements.name: Jan Complete
achievements.description: Learn all the lessons from your Alters

steps: Collect every Alter lesson: Assertiveness, Pragmatism, Reliance, Vulnerability, Optimism, Charisma, Joy of Life, Integrity, Chill and Shrewdness.
The last one usually lands after the rebellion quest and the Act 3 self-experiment.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: some side quests carry over between acts and some fail if you do not finish them in the same act — the game warns you when you try to travel onward.
warnings: If the achievement does not pop with the final lesson, open the lessons page and wait a few seconds — it fires from there.
Dropping a lesson early in an act can block its storyline too, and side quests do not always carry across acts.

steps: Craft an item in the workshop, hover it, then press the middle mouse button to add a production order.

achievements.name: Look at all this new space!
achievements.description: Expand the base for the first time

steps: Research the base upgrade on the technology page, gather the metal and minerals, then upgrade the base from the command room.

achievements.name: Jan's Moving Village
achievements.description: Expand the base to maximum capacity

steps: Finish the base upgrade research on the technology page.
Stockpile the metal and minerals each level asks for and upgrade the base in the command room all the way to level 4.
Walk up to the sheep near the base and press E to pet it.

achievements.name: The Corporate Way
achievements.description: Finish the game with the help of the corporation

steps: Take the corporation implant treatment in Act 2.
Act 3: talk to company executive Agatha and follow her task through to the ending.
warnings: Cooperating with Lena over the Alters does not block this — only the Act 2 treatment choice decides the ending route.

achievements.name: Maxwell's Path
achievements.description: Finish the game with Maxwell's help

steps: Act 2: sacrifice Tabula Rasa to treat the mutation.
Act 3: take Maxwell's call and see his task through to the ending.
warnings: Keep Lena in the dark about the Alters and do not follow the Botanist's advice in Act 2 if you want this route.
The ending must also be reached on the Maxwell route — the final choice after the goodbyes does not matter.

achievements.name: Advanced industry
achievements.description: Create the first portion of resources using the Refinery

steps: Build the Refinery in the command room and run any conversion or refinement job once.
In Act 2, walk into time-slowing anomalies and the spherical anomalies while exploring — both count.
To clear a time-slowing anomaly, aim at the small blue-rimmed black sphere inside it and shoot.
warnings: The counter runs for the whole campaign, so clear anomalies as you explore instead of farming them late.

achievements.name: The things we do for love

steps: Reach the final meeting with the rescue team after saying goodbye to the Alters.
When the Botanist proposes swapping identities, agree to it.
At the rescue team, choose to do nothing.
warnings: Ending branch: normalise saves are the only way back, so save before the last day.
Some players report unlocking this together with I deserved this more from the same save.

steps: In the final mission, craft and install the bomb.
After saying goodbye to the Alters, choose the detonation option at the rescue team meeting.
warnings: Ending branch — reload the last day to pick a different farewell option.

steps: In Act 1, stock enough radiation filters before the magnetic storm hits and wait it out.

achievements.name: New perspective
achievements.description: Get an alternative tattoo with Naranath Bhranthan

steps: Take the implant route in Act 2 and get the Doctor and the Psychologist through to Act 3.
Bring the rebels back so the Psychologist returns, then ask him for the tattoo design.
Build the tattoo machine, suggest the Naranath Bhranthan design to the Doctor and tattoo him.
warnings: The design only exists after the rebels are back — tattooing the Doctor earlier locks this out.

achievements.name: I deserved this more
achievements.description: Come back to Earth as the Botanist

steps: Reach the final goodbyes with the Botanist present.
Agree to let him take Jan's place.
At the meeting with the rescue team, pick the detonate/gas option.
warnings: Ending branch — save before the last day, and note that the Botanist must have swapped with you first.

achievements.name: All By Myself
achievements.description: Leave your Alters to the mercy of others

steps: Play through to the goodbye scene with the rescue team.
At the meeting choose to do nothing and leave your Alters behind.
warnings: Ending branch — only available from the last day, so keep a save there.

achievements.name: A Quantum Singularity
achievements.description: Earn all trophies in the Alters

steps: Earn the other 55 base-game achievements — the completion trophy fires on the last one.
Plan for two runs: one implant route and one Maxwell route, plus a normalised save at the finale for the four ending branches.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: players report 2–4 playthroughs for 100%, or two if you save-scum the finale.
warnings: The seven Last Variable DLC achievements are counted separately from this one.

steps: In the Last Variable campaign, unlock the Terraformer and place your first one on the map.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement — it does not appear in the base-game list.

steps: Unlock the Phased Rapidium recipe in the Last Variable campaign and run a production order for it.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement — it does not appear in the base-game list.

steps: Unlock the Proxylium recipe in the Last Variable campaign and start its production.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement — it does not appear in the base-game list.

steps: Unlock the Megafluid recipe in the Last Variable campaign and start its production.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement — it does not appear in the base-game list.

achievements.name: Wait, you can do that?
achievements.description: Create the same Alter for a second time

steps: Create an Alter you have already created once before, so the quantum computer produces the same Alter a second time.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement, and around a 3% unlock rate.
Neither of the two full achievement guides read for this file documents the trigger, so keep a manual save before experimenting.

steps: Play The Alters: Last Variable DLC — this achievement is not part of the base-game list.
Finish every storyline attached to the Scientist's Alters during that campaign, not just one of them.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement — it cannot be earned in the base campaign.

steps: Complete the Last Variable DLC campaign to its ending.
warnings: Last Variable DLC achievement.
